_comment: ADR 0027 — input bundle: WASD with first-person variant. 8 rules total: 4 world-frame (active when world_clock.camera_mode != first_person_3d) + 4 camera-relative (active when camera_mode == first_person_3d). Per-game physics.json splices via {$include: '@lib.input_bundles.wasd_with_fp_variant.rules'}. Action declarations under `actions` are FOR DOCUMENTATION; per-game ui/input.json still authors its own action list (the canonical InputMap declarations).

actions.name: stop
actions._doc: Engine-injected when no move_* key is held (world.gd::_poll_input → stop_action_on_idle). Per-game ui/input.json must declare {name:'stop', edge:'press'} so the InputRegistrar knows about it; without that, the engine's input queue never fires the stop rule and the player drifts after key release.

rules._comment: World-frame WASD — fires when camera is NOT first_person_3d. W=north regardless of player facing. Spliced into game's physics.json rules array. Per-axis pattern (added 2026-05-10): each directional rule sets ONLY its own axis. Engine's velocity_set preserves the OTHER axis when the field is omitted, so W+D = north + east diagonal works (each rule contributes one axis; combined velocity is (3, -3) at 45°). With both axes set per rule, last-writer-wins broke diagonals.

STOP — fires every tick when no movement key is held (engine queues 'stop' action via stop_action_on_idle in world.gd::_poll_input). Zeros both axes so player decelerates instantly. Without this rule, releasing W/A/S/D leaves velocity at the last non-zero value → player drifts forever. Empirical case 2026-05-10. Camera-mode-agnostic: works in both world-frame AND first_person_3d modes (FP mode also benefits from the explicit zero — relative-add lib didn't have this either).

Camera-relative WASD — fires when camera IS first_person_3d. Engine's velocity_add_relative reads actor.state.facing (mouse-driven by _camera_first_person_3d's _drain_mouse_facing) and rotates forward/strafe into world XZ, then ADDS to current velocity. W=mouse-aim-forward, S=back, A=strafe-left, D=strafe-right. velocity_add (not _set) lets W+D combine into a forward-right diagonal in same tick. Drag in motion integrator decelerates when no key held — but stop rule below explicitly zeros to avoid drift.
